Straight-through main J36 to receiver J36, one plug at each end: 1 logic GND, 2 HOST auxiliary, 3 LOCAL auxiliary, 4 HB_MON (3.3 V pulses), 5 PANEL_OK_MON (5 V). Monitor outputs feed high-impedance isolated inputs only. Separate from panel J8.
Select 28 to 24 AWG, insulation OD 0.76 to 1.20 mm. Obtain pre-crimped leads or use the matching crimp tooling.
Shrouded, polarized 2.50 mm inlet probe plug. Cavity 1 inlet electrode, 2 dedicated probe return. Use a short preterminated pair with a suitable field splice for a thicker installed cable.
Select 28 to 22 AWG conductors, insulation OD 0.90 to 1.90 mm. Retain the mated lead in the cabinet to limit vibration.

Straight-through main J31 to receiver J31, one plug at each end. Pins 1 and 2 connect exclusively to the isolated, closed-when-permitted external guard auxiliary. No shunt. Keep external 24 V and starter wiring off J31.

Touch-protected, keyed cabinet transfer for the selected guard profile. Provide distinct HOST and LOCAL positions. See hardware/starter-guard/README.rst for the required independent contact functions and ratings.
HOST and LOCAL full-seat switches. Select contacts rated for dry logic loads at approximately 0.30 mA. Insulate each contact mechanism from every starter-side conductor.
